title: MultihopSpatial: Multi-hop Compositional Spatial Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Model
abstract: arXiv:2603.18892v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Spatial reasoning is foundational for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), particularly when deployed as Vision-Language-Action (VLA) agents in physical environments. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on elementary, single-hop relations, neglecting the multi-hop compositional reasoning and precise visual grounding essential for real-world scenarios. To address this, we introduce MultihopSpatial, offering three key contributions: (1) A comprehensive benchmark designed for multi-hop and compositional spatial reasoning, featuring 1- to 3-hop complex queries across diverse spatial perspectives. translated_title: MultihopSpatial：面向视觉语言模型的多跳组合空间推理基准
translated_abstract: 空间推理是视觉语言模型（VLM）的基础能力，尤其当其作为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）智能体部署在物理环境中时更为关键。然而，现有基准主要关注基础的、单跳的关系，忽略了真实场景中至关重要的多跳组合推理和精确视觉定位能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了MultihopSpatial，包含三项关键贡献：（1）一个专为多跳组合空间推理设计的综合性基准，涵盖跨越多种空间视角的1至3跳复杂查询；（2）Acc@50IoU，一个互补的评估指标，通过同时要求答案选择与精确的边界框预测，来联合评估推理与视觉定位能力——这些能力对稳健的VLA部署至关重要；（3）MultihopSpatial-Train，一个专门构建的大规模训练语料库，用于培养空间智能。广泛的评估……
tldr: 该论文提出了MultihopSpatial基准，首次系统评测视觉语言模型的多跳组合空间推理能力，并通过Acc@50IoU指标联合评估推理与视觉定位，同时提供大规模训练语料MultihopSpatial-Train以提升模型空间智能。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MultihopSpatial, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating multi-hop compositional spatial reasoning in vision-language models, featuring the Acc@50IoU metric that jointly assesses reasoning and visual grounding, along with a large-scale training corpus MultihopSpatial-Train.
